boundary_or_countercase: platform does not satisfy the continuous offer-payment-delivery process condition
expected_if_framework_too_broad: any platform involved in the supply would be coded as the fiscal node
observed_boundary: platform liability is conditional; the foreign provider remains the baseline node outside the statutory continuous-process condition
research_use: direct falsifiability test for generic 'platform = collector' coding and direct evidence that process control conditions node allocation
next_test: identify transaction examples outside the continuous-process condition and compare provider/platform operational outcomes if available

boundary_or_countercase: VAT-registered Philippine buyer purchases covered digital service from NRDSP
expected_if_framework_too_broad: digital-platform/provider visibility would always place responsibility on the foreign provider or marketplace
observed_boundary: buyer-side withholding/reverse-charge path activates the domestic buyer as the fiscal node
research_use: alternative-node case showing transaction class can dominate generic platform status
next_test: compare B2B and B2C administration using matched legal fields and later operational outcomes if available

boundary_or_countercase: e-marketplace generates the sale but payment for the digital service is made directly to the NRDSP account
expected_if_framework_too_broad: marketplace presence or transaction generation alone would trigger marketplace VAT liability
observed_boundary: BIR RMC 47-2025 states the e-marketplace is not liable in this case because payment is outside marketplace control; marketplace presence alone is insufficient
research_use: strong within-regime boundary test for the operational-control proposition
next_test: trace additional marketplace scenarios where control over payment or supply terms changes the liable node

boundary_or_countercase: digital actor participates in PMSE but is not designated as collector
expected_if_framework_too_broad: all large/visible digital actors would automatically be fiscal nodes
observed_boundary: collector status is appointment-based; the coded fiscal duty attaches to designated PMSE collectors
research_use: boundary between commercial participation and legal fiscal-node activation
next_test: freeze designation criteria/current appointment process and study appointment waves as a later empirical design

boundary_or_countercase: foreign-supplier portal rail predates the household/individual-seller platform-withholding mechanism
expected_if_framework_too_broad: all Vietnamese digital-tax administration would be one platform-withholding architecture
observed_boundary: the 2022 foreign-supplier portal is a provider-centered precursor rail; Decree 117 later creates a distinct platform-withholding path for another legal object
research_use: guards against treating country-level chronology as a single node transition when tax objects differ
next_test: keep legal objects separated; search only same-object amendments for causal node-shift designs

boundary_or_countercase: SToDS and low-value-goods sales-tax regimes coexist
expected_if_framework_too_broad: all digital-commerce fiscal duties would be summarized as one Malaysian platform node
observed_boundary: SToDS and LVG are legally distinct instruments with different covered objects and role definitions
next_test: code LVG separately only if it adds analytical leverage; do not merge bases or revenue outcomes

boundary_or_countercase: seller operates on an e-commerce/digital platform that lacks the online-ordering/payment functionality required for the selected platform-withholding path
expected_if_framework_too_broad: platform mediation itself would always activate platform withholding
observed_boundary: the current 2026 framework distinguishes payment-capable/ordering platforms from other platforms; sellers outside that functional path remain responsible for the applicable self-declaration/payment route
research_use: within-jurisdiction functional countercase showing platform status alone is insufficient and payment/order control helps define node allocation
next_test: freeze the exact seller self-declaration fields and test whether later reforms move platforms across this functional boundary
